title: Protocol and Asset
author: Tamsin Dravenmoor
blurb: Emrys Montrose, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
